thesis: Map activities by competence and energy, then adjust, cut, build, and explore deliberately.
summary: The pursuit map places specific work and nonwork activities on competence and energy axes. High competence with low energy is labeled a danger zone because rewards can prolong an unsatisfying commitment. High energy with high competence is the desired zone; high energy with low competence is potential worth developing. Bloom then proposes four actions: adjust a draining activity, cut one or work toward cutting it, protect recurring time for a strong energizing pursuit, and add exploratory interests. The framework is a self-assessment tool rather than a validated career diagnosis.

insights.title: Evaluate specific activities rather than only job titles
insights.explanation: Breaking a role into tasks can reveal different combinations of skill and energy within the same job.
insights.quote: start with your job but break it down into the specific activities
insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Being rewarded for a skill can conceal low energy
insights.explanation: The danger zone combines external competence and reinforcement with a draining experience. The framework diagnoses an attention pattern, not objective job quality.
insights.quote: high competency but low energy you're good at it people praise you for it maybe you even get paid for it
insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Try modifying a draining activity
insights.explanation: The first action is an adjustment that might increase energy. Walking client calls are an example, showing that the framework does not demand abandoning every disliked responsibility.
insights.quote: think about how you might be able to adjust it in order to increase the energy you get from the activity
insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Keep room for energizing beginner interests
insights.explanation: Low present competence does not automatically disqualify an activity. The speaker encourages exploration and practice as pathways toward future capability.
insights.quote: new activities that spark genuine interest in energy even if you're just an embarrassing beginner at them
insights.speaker: unresolved

synthesis_method: Direct Codex extraction from complete local transcript; exact quotations verified locally
context_and_limits: Energy and competence ratings are subjective; market demand, obligations, and financial runway are not modeled. The video allows working toward a cut, not only immediate resignation. Transcript rendering of the cited author's name is uncertain.
review_changes: Adds the often-missed adjustment option and beginner zone, avoiding a simplistic quit-everything-draining interpretation.
